section_summary.extract_value: This correlations section reports that BMI was the only variable significantly associated with body appreciation, described as a negative, moderate correlation; no numeric correlation coefficient is provided. Several relationships among self-compassionate engagement, self-compassionate action, AAQ-II (experiential avoidance/psychological inflexibility), and body appreciation are described (negative/positive and varying magnitudes). The section does not label separate studies (use Study X) and provides no sample, country, or measurement-method details.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Body mass index was only significantly associated to body appreciation, with a negative and moderate correlation coefficient." Additional sentences: "Self-compassionate engagement presented a negative and moderate correlation with the measure of experiential avoidance and psychological inflexibility (AAQ-II) and positive associations with self-compassionate action (with strong magnitude) and with body appreciation (with moderate magnitude). The AAQ-II correlated negatively and strongly with self-compassionate action and with body appreciation. Finally, self-compassionate action and body appreciation presented a positive correlation of moderate magnitude."
